self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Lithic Axiom: Unity: for each party member (including the wielder) who hails from Liyue, ATK +11% and CRIT Rate +7%, max 4 stacks. Select the number of Liyue party members.

en.flavor: A greatsword carved and chiseled from the very bedrock of Liyue.

refinements.1: For every character in the party who hails from Liyue, the character who equips this weapon gains a <r>7%</r> ATK increase and a <r>3%</r> CRIT Rate increase. This effect stacks up to 4 times.
refinements.2: For every character in the party who hails from Liyue, the character who equips this weapon gains a <r>8%</r> ATK increase and a <r>4%</r> CRIT Rate increase. This effect stacks up to 4 times.
refinements.3: For every character in the party who hails from Liyue, the character who equips this weapon gains a <r>9%</r> ATK increase and a <r>5%</r> CRIT Rate increase. This effect stacks up to 4 times.
refinements.4: For every character in the party who hails from Liyue, the character who equips this weapon gains a <r>10%</r> ATK increase and a <r>6%</r> CRIT Rate increase. This effect stacks up to 4 times.
refinements.5: For every character in the party who hails from Liyue, the character who equips this weapon gains a <r>11%</r> ATK increase and a <r>7%</r> CRIT Rate increase. This effect stacks up to 4 times.

fr.flavor: Une grande épée qui a été taillée à partir du substrat rocheux de Liyue.
